legal.privacySubtitle: What this site collects and what we do with it.
legal.termsSubtitle: The rules for using this website and the online appointment request.
legal.controllerPending: The registered company details will be published before the site goes live.
legal.dataIntro: We collect only what you type into one of the forms on this site. We use no analytics, no advertising cookies and no visitor tracking.
legal.dataContact: Contact form: name, email address, phone number (optional), subject and message.
legal.dataAppointment: Appointment request: name, email address, phone number, the service, dentist and time you selected, and a note if you add one.
legal.dataTestimonial: Review: the name you give, a rating, the review text and a service name if you add one.
legal.dataNote: The note field on the appointment request is free text. Please do not put detailed health information in it; we will discuss that in person or by phone.
legal.purposeText: Only to answer your enquiry, to confirm or move an appointment, and to publish a review after we have checked it. We do not sell your data or use it for marketing without your consent.
legal.storageText: Submissions are stored in a database (Neon, PostgreSQL) and sent as email through Resend. The site is hosted on Vercel. These providers process the data on our behalf.
legal.retentionText: We keep enquiries and appointment requests for as long as we need them to correspond with you and to keep a record of appointments. A published review stays visible until you ask us to remove it.
legal.cookiesText: The public part of this site sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser. Cookies are used only to sign staff in to the admin area.
legal.mapText: The contact page embeds a location map from Google Maps. Loading it connects your browser to Google servers, which is covered by their privacy policy.
legal.rightsText: You can ask what we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, and withdraw a review. Get in touch using the details on the contact page.
legal.termsUseText: The content here is for information. Service descriptions and blog articles are not medical advice and do not replace an examination by a dentist.
legal.termsBookingTitle: A request is not a confirmed appointment
legal.termsBookingText: The booking form sends a request. The time is reserved only once we confirm it by phone or email. If you cannot make it, please let us know in advance.
legal.termsPricesText: Any durations and prices shown are indicative and apply to a standard treatment. The final price is set after an examination and treatment plan.
legal.termsReviewsText: We publish reviews only after checking them. We may decline to publish content that is abusive, untrue, or contains personal details of other people.
legal.termsContentText: The text, photographs and visual identity on this site belong to Enamel unless stated otherwise.
legal.termsChangesText: We may update these terms from time to time. The date of the last change is shown at the top of this page.
